_note: Gate fixture for tests/plan_collision_test.gd. One plain wall per wall axis, each on its own 20 m station so a perpendicular ray family crosses exactly one of them. No openings and no two-sided skins on purpose: opening casing stands FRAME_PROUD of the panel with no collider behind it, and that pre-existing gap would muddy a threshold measured in millimetres.
_note2: Two-sided on purpose: the half-thickness skins stand SKIN_EPS proud of the collider, which is the ~0.0098 m the correct bake legitimately leaves uncovered and what the test's depth threshold is calibrated against.
